macro_bullets: Middle East war escalates as Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport kill three and Hormuz tanker attacks hit a wartime peak, prompting airlines to suspend flights.
Trump's diplomatic tone on Iran eased supply fears, pulling oil lower while gold hit a one-week high.
Treasury yields remain elevated with warnings of a worsening bond rout, though some options traders are calling a bottom after this week's 10-year auction.
An AI-driven selloff dragged semiconductor and memory names sharply lower, led by an OpenAI revenue report and disappointing Samsung preliminary results.
SpaceX's $8 billion spectrum purchase reshaped telecom and space names, hammering telcos while boosting tower operators.
internals_narrative: Energy (+2.8%) and Consumer Staples (+2.4%) led sectors while Semiconductors (-3.0%), Memory (-5.0%) and Robotics & Hardware (-5.6%) lagged badly, with refiners and consumer names like CMG, ACN, MPC and STZ topping gainers and chip/memory names IREN, ORCL, INTC, MU and AVGO among the biggest losers.

ticker_notes.CMG: Chipotle jumped ~6% on a report Starbucks could pursue a takeover, though analysts see limited odds of a deal.
ticker_notes.ACN: Accenture rallied as AI-fear names rebounded following a Q4 beat and calls that it may be 30% undervalued.
ticker_notes.MPC: Refiners drew buyer interest amid surging diesel prices.
ticker_notes.VLO: Valero rose with refiners as diesel prices spiked.
ticker_notes.STZ: Constellation Brands climbed ~9% after an earnings beat and its SpikedAde deal announcement.
ticker_notes.PM: Philip Morris framed as a rising-dividend safe harbor ahead of Q3.
ticker_notes.LOW: Analysts debated whether the weak housing market makes Lowe's an attractive entry point.
ticker_notes.IREN: IREN fell after SemiAnalysis flagged questions about its Canadian data centers amid the AI selloff.
ticker_notes.ORCL: Oracle slid alongside CoreWeave's near-8% drop tied to an OpenAI revenue report.
ticker_notes.INTC: Intel dropped as an OpenAI revenue report hit chip stocks broadly.
ticker_notes.OUST: Ouster fell with nuclear and tech-hardware names amid Middle East energy-cost concerns.
ticker_notes.DRAM: Memory names slid in sync after Samsung's preliminary results disappointed.
ticker_notes.SNDK: SanDisk fell in the broad memory selloff.
ticker_notes.RKLB: Rocket Lab lost nearly 9% over two days as SpaceX's spectrum moves pressured space stocks.
ticker_notes.BA: TD Cowen called the aerospace de-rating 'disorderly' and cut its Boeing target.
ticker_notes.AMT: American Tower jumped 8.6% as SpaceX's spectrum buy kept tower-build demand alive.
ticker_notes.CHTR: Charter remained under pressure after plunging in September ahead of its Q3 report.
ticker_notes.AIG: AIG saw mixed analyst moves, with Mizuho and Morgan Stanley trimming targets.
ticker_notes.APD: Air Products won a deal to supply Malaysia's first LNG-based air separation unit for a PETRONAS-led JV.
ticker_notes.ABBV: Cantor Fitzgerald lifted price targets on AbbVie and other pharma giants.
ticker_notes.AEP: American Electric Power eyed as a data-center-buildout dividend play.
